statements.t: Blesses the Hebron attack and calls on the public to rise up for Al-Aqsa and the prisoners.
Blesses the Hebron attack, mourns the attackers and calls for escalation in the West Bank.
Calls the Hebron attack part of a “natural and legitimate response” to settler terror and the war in Gaza.
Claims it hit Israeli vehicles raiding Silat al-Dhahr with explosive devices.
Denies a Yedioth Ahronoth report that Hamas threatened an Oct 7-style attack and reaffirms the ceasefire.
Claims heavy fire on a settler bus on the road to Mevo Dotan.
On the third anniversary of Oct 7, asks what would happen if a “western front” were opened against Israel.
Calls an attack on soldiers at the Beit Ur checkpoint a “natural response” to settler attacks and Al-Aqsa raids.
On the Al-Aqsa arson anniversary, calls on West Bank and Jerusalem residents to rise up and confront settlers.
